visualCharacteristics.description: Horizontal scroll track (3 visible) with prev/next arrows; image-top white cards, purple type badge, serif title, clamped excerpt, right-aligned 'Read More ->'.

contentPattern.rows: One row per card: [image cell (may be empty but present)] [text cell: richtext]
contentPattern.usedAs: 6 rows, image = article image, text = badge p + H3 + p + link
contentPattern.reason: Dynamic list: each item links to an insight detail page with a type tag, and the track scrolls with prev/next. Cards (not Carousel) per the dynamic-list rule; the variant adds the horizontal scroller.

reuseGuidance: Use for horizontally scrolling article/case-study cards with type badge.
